title: potentilla cinerea var. tommasiniana
intro: Potentilla cinerea var. tommasiniana, commonly known as Alpine Cinquefoil, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it effective in treating digestive issues, wounds, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Cinquefoil include antiseptic, antiviral, and antifungal properties, which help in reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
